verdicts.reason: Both use the same sound banner structure: the headline dominates, the CTA sits at bottom left and the legal text sits beside it. In both, the Solstice can is shrunk so far that its label can't be read and it reads as a minor corner graphic rather than the hero, and the legal text is tiny and wraps to four lines. A turns the light-blue circle into a backdrop for the GLACIER logo, which is odd but tidy. In B, the light-blue circle is cropped at the bottom-right edge and cuts through the legal text, an unintended overlap, so A is slightly cleaner.
